answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a grove of verified economic participants. Just as a raven must forage to survive, an attacker incurs a prohibitive cost by purchasing stakes to influence a lagoon of consensus validators. This capital-intensive barrier ensures that identity duplication leads to financial ruin rather than system compromise, as the cost of acquiring sufficient stake scales linearly with the network size.
